policy: Personas are owned and evidenced in the product or knowledge repository listed under sources. This register only indexes them: it links the names each repository uses and the canonical reviewer agents that act as a lens for each persona. A reviewer agent is a perspective, not a persona, and gains no authority from this mapping. Statuses come from the owning source; nothing here validates a persona.

personas.title: Merchant
personas.description: A business accepting payments that operates its own account through portals and APIs.

personas.title: Acquiring partner
personas.description: A bank or acquiring entity that underwrites and boards merchants and configures processing. Called a boarding partner on VAS SMB.

personas.title: Independent sales organization (ISO)
personas.description: A partner that sells and services merchant portfolios without being the acquiring bank. Distinct needs not yet evidenced.
personas.gap: No reviewer agent owns the ISO or reseller portfolio perspective; kaidan covers partner onboarding only.

personas.title: Referral partner
personas.description: Refers merchants and receives referral compensation without operating their accounts.
personas.gap: No reviewer agent covers referral partners. Commerce groups referral with tech and ISV partners.

personas.title: ISV (software or plugin provider)
personas.description: Builds software that connects merchants to the gateway, may refer or embed merchant signup, and attributes traffic (Solution ID on ANET). Called a technology partner on VAS SMB.
personas.gap: Reviewers cover the integration build, not the ISV's business view (attribution, referral, marketplace).

personas.title: Tech partner (custom integrator)
personas.description: Builds bespoke integrations and may also refer merchants. Whether this is distinct from ISV is an open question in Commerce.

personas.title: Developer
personas.description: The person writing the integration, whether at a merchant, ISV, or tech partner. A role audience, not an account.

personas.title: Internal (support and operations)
personas.description: Internal staff who support merchants and partners.

personas.title: Payer
personas.description: The customer paying a merchant. Commerce keeps this as a transactional journey, not an account persona.
personas.gap: No reviewer owns the payer end to end (receipts, disputes, stored credentials) beyond checkout.

personas.title: AI agent consumer
personas.description: An automated agent consuming APIs, docs, or MCP tools on a person's behalf.
